result.brief: 提出 Prism 动态稀疏注意力框架，按时空宏区自适应分配块形状，利用视频特征方差与音到视频交叉注意力估计局部信息结构，实现 2K 原生联合音视频生成训练加速。
result.reason: Dynamic sparse attention for natively training joint video-audio generation at 2K, with audio-to-video cross-attention structure; directly serves joint audio-video generation and video generation efficiency.
